line: Lily, when I was held captive on the Borg ship, my crew risked every thing to save me. There is ...someone still on this ship, and I owe him the same.

line: Go and find your friend.

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: What's wrong Locutus? Isn't this familiar?

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: Organic minds are such fragile things. How could you forget me so quickly? We were very close, you and I. You can still hear our song.

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: Yes, ...I remember you. You were there all the time. But that ship and all the Borg on it were destroyed.

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: You think in such three-dimensional terms. How small you've become. Data understands me. Don't you, Data?

line: What have you done to him?

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: Given him what he always wanted, flesh and blood.

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: Let him go. He's not the one you want.

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: Are you offering yourself to us?

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: Offering myself? ...That's it. I remember now. It wasn't enough that you assimilate me. I had to give myself freely to the Borg, ...to you.

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: You flatter yourself. I've overseen the assimilation of countless millions. You were no different.

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: You're lying. You wanted more than just another Borg drone. You wanted a human being with a mind of his own, who could bridge the gulf between humanity and the Borg. You wanted a counterpart, but I resisted. I fought you.

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: You can't begin to imagine the life you denied yourself.

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: It's not too late. Locutus could still be with you, just in the way you wanted. An equal. Let Data go and I will take my place at your side, willingly without any resistance.

line: Such a noble creature. A quality we sometimes lack. We will add your distinctiveness to our own. Welcome home, ...Locutus. ...Data, you are free to go.

line: As you can see I have already found an equal. Data! Deactivate the self-destruct sequence.

line: I would imagine that I look worse than I ...feel. ...Strange. ...Part of me is sorry she is dead.

line: She was unique.

line: She brought me closer to humanity than I could have thought possible. And for a time I was tempted by her offer.

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: How long a time?

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: Zero point six eight seconds, sir. For an android ...that is nearly an eternity. Captain's log, April 5th 2063. The voyage of the Phoenix was a success, ...again. The alien ship detected the warp signature and is on its way to rendezvous with history.

title: Star Trek: First Contact
line: By God! They're really from another world.

line: And they're going to want to meet the man who flew that warp ship.
